title: The Return Map in the Class $\mathcal{O}_C$: Geometry, Dynamics, and Thickness Regularity
summary: We study a discrete dynamical system $F = π\circ Φ$ on the boundary of a convex core $\partial C \subset \mathbb{R}^N$, generated by linking $C$ to an outer boundary $\partialΩ$ via normal rays and a thickness function $d$. We derive the local expansion $F(c) - c = d(c)\bigl(I - d(c)S_c\bigr)^{-1}\nabla_{\partial C}d(c) + O\bigl(\vert{}\nabla_{\partial C}d(c)\vert{}^2\bigr)$, showing how curvature precalculates thickness gradients.
